cod-profit-calculator.intro: Cash on delivery profit is decided after the order: by how many orders get confirmed and how many the courier delivers. Enter your funnel and costs to see what you keep after returns and ads.
cod-profit-calculator.formula:
Confirmed = Placed × confirmation rate
Delivered = Confirmed × delivery rate
Returned = Confirmed − Delivered
Revenue = Delivered × order value
Profit = Revenue − COD fee
  − Delivered × (COGS + shipping)
  − Returned × (shipping + return fee)
  − Returned × COGS × unsellable share
  − Ad spend

outputs.profit: Net profit after RTO and ads

margin-markup-calculator.intro: Margin and markup use the same two numbers and give different answers. Enter your cost and price to see both, plus the price you need to hit a target margin.
margin-markup-calculator.formula:
Margin = (Price − Cost) ÷ Price
Markup = (Price − Cost) ÷ Cost
Price for a target margin = Cost ÷ (1 − margin)
Max cost at a target margin = Price × (1 − margin)

outputs.maxCost: Max cost at your target margin

break-even-calculator.intro: Find how many orders a month you need before the business stops losing money, how many you need for a profit target, and where you stand today.
break-even-calculator.formula:
Contribution = AOV − variable cost − ad cost per order
Break-even orders = ⌈Fixed costs ÷ Contribution⌉
Orders for a profit target = ⌈(Fixed + target) ÷ Contribution⌉
Margin of safety = (Current orders − Break-even) ÷ Current orders

product-pricing-calculator.intro: Work back from your costs to the price that keeps the margin you want, after shipping, payment fees and your share of fixed costs.
product-pricing-calculator.formula:
Fixed per unit = Fixed costs ÷ units per month
Price = (COGS + shipping + fixed per unit + fixed fee)
        ÷ (1 − fee % − target margin)
Price with tax = Price × (1 + tax rate)

contribution-margin-calculator.intro: See what one order really leaves after product cost, shipping, payment fees and the ad cost to get it, and how much ad cost an order can carry.
contribution-margin-calculator.formula:
Contribution = Price − COGS − shipping − Price × fee % − ad cost
Contribution ratio = Contribution ÷ Price
Max ad cost per order = Price − COGS − shipping − fees
Break-even ROAS = Price ÷ max ad cost per order

landed-cost-calculator.intro: Your supplier price is not your product cost. Add freight, customs duty, clearance and local delivery to see what each unit costs when it reaches your shelf.
landed-cost-calculator.formula:
Freight per unit = Freight ÷ units
Duty per unit = (Supplier price + freight per unit) × duty %   (CIF)
             = Supplier price × duty %                        (FOB)
Landed = Supplier price + freight + duty + clearance + local delivery (per unit)
Max supplier price = (Price × (1 − fee % − target) − freight × (1 + duty if CIF)
                     − clearance − local) ÷ (1 + duty %)

outputs.load: Added on top of supplier price
outputs.maxSupplier: Max supplier price for your target

payment-fee-calculator.intro: See what your payment gateway takes each month, the rate you really pay once fixed fees are added, and what moving sales off a marketplace would save.
payment-fee-calculator.formula:
Gateway fees = Revenue × rate + Orders × fixed fee
Tax on fees = Gateway fees × tax rate
Effective rate = (Fees + tax) ÷ Revenue
Moved sales = Marketplace sales × 12 × share moved
Yearly saving = Moved × commission − Moved × gateway rate − site cost

wholesale-margin-calculator.intro: Check that your wholesale price leaves enough for you and for the retailer, and compare it with selling the same product yourself.
wholesale-margin-calculator.formula:
Your wholesale margin = (Wholesale − Cost) ÷ Wholesale
Wholesale markup = (Wholesale − Cost) ÷ Cost
Retailer margin = (Retail − Wholesale) ÷ Retail
Direct margin = (Retail − Cost) ÷ Retail

roas-calculator.intro: A ROAS number means nothing until you know the line it has to beat. Enter spend, revenue and margin to see your ROAS next to your break-even and target ROAS.
roas-calculator.formula:
ROAS = Revenue ÷ Ad spend
Break-even ROAS = 1 ÷ margin
Target ROAS = 1 ÷ (margin − target net margin)
Profit after ads = Revenue × margin − Ad spend
POAS = Profit after ads ÷ Ad spend

outputs.targetRoas: ROAS for your target net margin
outputs.adShare: Ad spend as share of revenue

max-cpa-calculator.intro: Find the most you can pay for one order on Meta or TikTok and still make money, for cash on delivery with returns and for prepaid orders.
max-cpa-calculator.formula:
Profit per delivered = Price − COGS − shipping − fees
Prepaid max CPA = Profit per delivered
COD max per placed order = confirm % × (deliver % × profit per delivered
                           − (1 − deliver %) × (shipping + return fee))
Max CPC = Max per order × click → order rate

outputs.maxPerOrder: Max ad cost per placed order (COD)

ad-budget-calculator.intro: Start from the revenue you want, get the ad budget it takes, then check whether your CPM, click rate and conversion rate can actually deliver it.
ad-budget-calculator.formula:
Budget = Revenue goal ÷ target ROAS
Daily budget = Budget ÷ 30.4
Clicks = Budget ÷ CPM × 1,000 × CTR
Orders = Clicks × conversion rate
Funnel revenue = Orders × AOV

mer-calculator.intro: MER (marketing efficiency ratio) checks all your marketing against all your revenue, so no platform can take credit for sales it didn't make.
mer-calculator.formula:
Marketing = Paid ads + email + agency + tools
MER = Total revenue ÷ Marketing
Break-even MER = 1 ÷ margin
Profit after marketing = Revenue × margin − Marketing
Over-claim = Platform revenue − Total revenue × (platform spend ÷ paid spend)

outputs.overClaim: Revenue Meta claims beyond its share

ad-metrics-calculator.h1: CPA, CPM, CPC and CTR calculator
ad-metrics-calculator.intro: Turn five numbers from any ad account into the six metrics that explain a campaign: CPA, CPM, CTR, CPC, conversion rate and ROAS.
ad-metrics-calculator.formula:
CPM = Spend ÷ Impressions × 1,000
CTR = Clicks ÷ Impressions
CPC = Spend ÷ Clicks
Conversion rate = Orders ÷ Clicks
CPA = Spend ÷ Orders
ROAS = Revenue ÷ Spend

ad-frequency-calculator.intro: See how often the same people see your ads, per week and per creative, and how many days each creative has before it hits the limit you set.
ad-frequency-calculator.formula:
Frequency = Impressions ÷ Reach
Weekly frequency = Frequency ÷ days × 7
Per creative = Frequency ÷ active creatives
Days to limit = Limit ÷ (Frequency ÷ days ÷ creatives)

outputs.daysToLimit: Days until a creative hits your limit

influencer-roi-calculator.intro: Check whether a creator paid back: ROI, ROAS and cost per order from the fee and product you sent, plus what the same reach would cost in ads.
influencer-roi-calculator.formula:
Cost = Fee + product sent
ROI = (Revenue − Cost) ÷ Cost
ROAS = Revenue ÷ Cost
Cost per order = Cost ÷ Orders
Media value = Impressions × your CPM ÷ 1,000

courier-cost-calculator.intro: The cheapest courier is not always the one that earns you the most. Compare three couriers by cost per delivered order and profit per shipment, with returns included.
courier-cost-calculator.formula:
Cost per shipment = Fee + (1 − delivery rate) × return fee
Cost per delivered order = Cost per shipment ÷ delivery rate
Profit per shipment = Delivery rate × (order value − COGS) − cost per shipment
Monthly gap = (Best − cheapest profit per shipment) × shipments

outputs.aPerDelivered: Courier A: cost per delivered order
outputs.bPerDelivered: Courier B: cost per delivered order
outputs.cPerDelivered: Courier C: cost per delivered order

returns-cost-calculator.intro: A return costs more than the refund suggests and less than many calculators claim. See the real cost per return and what your return rate does to break-even ROAS.
returns-cost-calculator.formula:
Margin per order = AOV − COGS − shipping out
Out of pocket per return = shipping out + return shipping + handling
                           + COGS × (1 − resold %)
Cost per return = Margin + out of pocket
Kept per order = (1 − rate) × margin − rate × out of pocket
Break-even ROAS = AOV ÷ kept per order
Max return rate = Margin ÷ (margin + out of pocket)

outputs.maxRate: Return rate where profit hits zero

discount-calculator.intro: Before you run a sale, see how many extra orders the discount needs just to earn the same profit, and what happens at the lift you expect.
discount-calculator.formula:
Margin m = (Price − Cost) ÷ Price
Orders needed = d ÷ (m − d)
Profit at full price = (Price − Cost) × Orders
Profit with discount = (Price × (1 − d) − Cost) × Orders × (1 + lift)
Discount cost per extra order = Discount given ÷ extra orders

outputs.liftNeeded: Extra orders needed to break even

free-shipping-threshold-calculator.intro: Set free shipping where the extra order value pays for the shipping you absorb. See the threshold your margin supports and test any threshold against it.
free-shipping-threshold-calculator.formula:
Suggested threshold = AOV + shipping ÷ margin (rounded up to 5)
AOV lift = (Threshold − AOV) × share reaching it
Shipping absorbed = Orders × share × shipping
Extra profit = Orders × AOV lift × margin
Net = Extra profit − shipping absorbed

upsell-calculator.intro: See what an upsell or cross-sell is worth: extra revenue and profit, the new average order value, and the effect over a year.
upsell-calculator.formula:
Extra revenue = Orders × take rate × upsell price
Extra profit = Extra revenue × upsell margin
New AOV = AOV + take rate × upsell price

bogo-calculator.intro: See what a buy X get Y offer really costs you: the effective discount, the price per unit and your profit on the whole set.
bogo-calculator.formula:
Effective discount = Y ÷ (X + Y)
Customer pays = X × price
Profit on the set = X × price − (X + Y) × cost
Margin after offer = Profit ÷ customer pays

outputs.singleProfit: Profit on one unit at full price

quantity-discount-calculator.intro: Check whether a 'buy 3, save 15%' tier earns more than selling one unit, and how many tier buyers need to be real upgrades for it to pay off.
quantity-discount-calculator.formula:
Tier total = Qty × price × (1 − discount)
Tier profit = Tier total − qty × cost − order cost − fee % × tier total
Single profit = Price − cost − order cost − fee % × price
Pays off when upgraded share ≥ loss ÷ (gain + loss)

outputs.paysOffShare: Pays off if this share of tier buyers are upgrades

free-gift-vs-discount-calculator.intro: Both offers push customers to spend more. Compare a free gift and a percentage discount at the same threshold and see which one keeps more profit.
free-gift-vs-discount-calculator.formula:
Extra profit = (Threshold − AOV) × orders × margin
With gift = Extra profit − gift cost × orders
With discount = Extra profit − threshold × discount × orders

customer-lifetime-value-calculator.intro: Work out what one customer is worth over the time they buy from you, in revenue and in profit, and the most you can pay to win one.
customer-lifetime-value-calculator.formula:
Revenue CLV = AOV × orders per year × years
Profit CLV = Revenue CLV × margin
LTV:CAC = Profit CLV ÷ CAC
Max CAC = Profit CLV ÷ target ratio

outputs.maxCac: Max CAC at your target ratio

customer-acquisition-cost-calculator.intro: See what a new customer costs you, whether the first order pays it back, and how many months it takes to earn it back if not.
customer-acquisition-cost-calculator.formula:
CAC = Marketing spend ÷ new customers
Profit per order = AOV × margin
First-order profit = Profit per order − CAC
Payback months = CAC ÷ (Profit per order × orders per year ÷ 12)
LTV:CAC = Profit per order × orders per year × years ÷ CAC

retention-rate-calculator.intro: See how many customers you keep and lose in a period, how long an average customer stays, and the right way to turn yearly churn into monthly.
retention-rate-calculator.formula:
Lost = Start + New − End
Retention = (End − New) ÷ Start
Churn = Lost ÷ Start
Average lifetime = 1 ÷ churn (in periods)
Monthly churn from annual = 1 − (1 − annual)^(1/12)

loyalty-program-roi-calculator.intro: Before you launch a loyalty program, see what a higher repeat rate is worth in extra customers, revenue and profit over a year.
loyalty-program-roi-calculator.formula:
Extra repeat customers = Customers × (rate with program − rate now)
Extra revenue per month = Extra customers × AOV
Extra revenue per year = Extra customers × AOV × repeat orders per year
Extra profit per year = Extra revenue per year × margin

conversion-rate-calculator.intro: See your conversion rate and revenue per visitor, and what reaching a target conversion rate would add to revenue with the same traffic.
conversion-rate-calculator.formula:
Conversion rate = Orders ÷ Sessions
RPV = Revenue ÷ Sessions
AOV = Revenue ÷ Orders
Orders at target = Sessions × target rate
Extra revenue = (Orders at target − orders) × AOV

outputs.extra: Extra revenue at the target rate

cart-abandonment-calculator.intro: See how much revenue is left in checkouts people start and don't finish, and what a recovery message on WhatsApp or email could bring back.
cart-abandonment-calculator.formula:
Abandonment rate = 1 − completed ÷ started
Revenue left = (Started − completed) × AOV
Recoverable = Revenue left × recovery rate

ab-test-duration-calculator.intro: Find out how many visitors each version needs and how many days your test must run before you can trust the result.
ab-test-duration-calculator.formula:
p₂ = p₁ × (1 + lift)
n per variant = (z_α × √(2p̄(1 − p̄)) + z_β × √(p₁(1 − p₁) + p₂(1 − p₂)))²
                ÷ (p₂ − p₁)²
Days = n ÷ (daily visitors ÷ 2), at least 7

email-list-value-calculator.intro: See what your email list earns each month, what each subscriber is worth over a year, and whether email pays for its cost.
email-list-value-calculator.formula:
Revenue per send = Open rate × click-to-open × conversion × AOV
Monthly revenue = Revenue per send × sends × subscribers
Profit = Monthly revenue × margin − email cost
Value per subscriber per year = Revenue per send × sends × 12

reorder-point-calculator.intro: Know when to reorder and how much: reorder point and safety stock by two methods, plus the order size that keeps ordering and holding costs lowest.
reorder-point-calculator.formula:
Reorder point = Daily sales × lead time + safety stock
Safety (max method) = Peak daily × longest lead − daily × lead
Safety (statistical) = z × √(lead × σ_demand² + daily² × σ_lead²)
EOQ = √(2 × yearly demand × order cost ÷ (unit cost × holding %))

inventory-turnover-calculator.intro: See how fast your stock sells, what it earns for every unit of money tied up in it, and how many days you have left before you run out.
inventory-turnover-calculator.formula:
Turnover = COGS ÷ average inventory value
Days to sell = 365 ÷ turnover
GMROI = (Revenue − COGS) ÷ average inventory value
Days left = Units in stock ÷ units sold per day
Reorder in = Days left − lead time

sales-forecast-calculator.intro: Project where steady monthly growth takes your revenue: month by month, the final month and the total for the period.
sales-forecast-calculator.formula:
Month n revenue = Base × (1 + growth)^n
Total = sum of months 1 to n
Growth vs today = Final month ÷ base − 1

volumetric-weight-calculator.intro: Couriers bill the bigger of the actual weight and the space a parcel takes. See which one you are paying for.
volumetric-weight-calculator.formula:
Volumetric weight = L × W × H (cm) ÷ divisor
Chargeable weight = max(actual, volumetric)
